background_music.description: Description of the style/mood of background music.

call_to_action.description: Text of actions the video asks viewers to take.

content_category.description: AI classification of content (e.g., Comedy, Sports).

faces_age_estimate.description: Estimated age range of faces visible in the video.

faces_ethnicity.description: List of ethnicities for all faces detected.

faces_gender.description: List of genders for all faces detected.

main_activity.description: Primary action occurring in the video (verb + object).

main_ethnicity.description: Primary ethnic group represented in the video.

main_gender.description: Primary gender represented in the video.

multilingual.description: Are multiple languages spoken or sung in the video? (Yes/No).

objects.description: List of physical items detected in the video.

primary_country.description: Country the video is primarily connected to (creator origin / subject / audience).

speech_vs_music.description: Ratio of spoken word to background music.

spoken_language.description: Primary language spoken or sung in the video.

symbols_and_brands.description: Visible logos, flags, or symbols detected by AI.

tiktok_native.description: Does the video use styles/formats native to the platform it appears on? (Yes/No).

trend_cultural.description: Does the video replicate a cultural short-video trend (participatory format like a dance/meme)? (Yes/No).

trend_technical.description: Does the video leverage a technical short-video trend (trending template/effect/sound)? (Yes/No).

video_story.description: Concise AI-generated narrative summary of the video.
